company.name: Qapa
company.shortDescription: Qapa is a job matching marketplace that connects job seekers and recruiters with a matching algorithm.
company.description: Qapa is a social job matching marketplace. Its ambition is to build the next generation of job board. With a 100% free job posting model, a proactive and real-time matching between candidates and offers, Qapa revolutionizes the online recruitment.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app that allows users to manage their temporary work assignments, apply for jobs, sign contracts, view pay slips, and request advances.
productsAndServices.name: QAPA Mobile Application

productsAndServices.description: An algorithm that analyzes user experiences and qualifications to automatically suggest relevant job offers via email, SMS, and voice messages.
productsAndServices.name: Job Matching Algorithm

productsAndServices.description: A service that handles all aspects of temporary work assignments, including contracts, work hours tracking, pay slips, and salary payments.
productsAndServices.name: Temporary Work Management

productsAndServices.description: Job offers available across various sectors such as logistics, commerce, industry, health, and banking throughout France.
productsAndServices.name: Sector-Specific Job Offers

productsAndServices.description: Email and SMS alerts sent to candidates when a job matching their profile becomes available.
productsAndServices.name: Candidate Alerts

productsAndServices.description: A feature allowing users to upload and manage necessary documents like CVs, identity papers, and social security cards.
productsAndServices.name: Document Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,835,173, or 82.99% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $50,735,895 to $50,735,895, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 27 (+5 over 90 days) and market heat at 38 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Indeed, ManpowerGroup, Kelly Services.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
